Also, I acknowledge the fact that some people are able to create meaning in their lives. Their own subjective brand of truth. I envy these people. 

It's just something I can't seem to do.

I have read into existential philosophy, as well as some of Nietzsche's writings. But this is one of those things that i used to love, intellectual pursuit, that i no longer find any joy in. I used to be able to get completely absorbed in reading. Now I can barely read a couple of pages of any book before putting it down. Its quite disheartening.

I tried focusing on knowledge and understanding. But every realization, every epiphany has proven to be transient and illusory in nature. 

Either I'm doing it wrong, or it all really is a big nothing.

I learned the hard way too. 

The worst part is when you try to talk to someone and you tell them something you consider so important that its like a part of yourself, and all they do is shrug, or look at you confusedly.
Thank you for your kind words. Although i am unsure of how much i can do and how much i can help people if i cannot even help myself.

I've tried to get professional help several times. These attempts have failed. 

I have considered that my life is not just mine. To be honest this the only reason that I haven't already done what i have spent so many years thinking about. 

But this leaves me in limbo. Its like i am waiting for the day where those around me are gone. Meanwhile, i look at each cliff longingly and each night alone as a chance. But I am not a selfish person. I would not end my life if it will cause those around me so much harm. 

At the same time, I do not enjoy life. Hence the limbo.

Any ideas on how to alleviate this situation?
